sourceNotes.rawContent:
A rich, gold-toned gift hamper that brings together elegant everyday jewellery with indulgent chocolate treats. Packed in a signature pink gift box with satin and dried flower styling — perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or a luxe "just because" surprise.
What's Inside:
- Gold-Tone Rope Chain Bracelet
- Ruby & Emerald Stone Necklace
- Gold-Tone Twisted Hoop Earrings
- Satin Scrunchie – Rose Gold
- Gold-Tone Acrylic Bangle/Cuff
- Hershey's Kisses – Milk Chocolate
- Sunfeast Dark Fantasy Coffee Fills
- Decorative Pink Flower Accent
Why She'll Love It:
- A complete gold jewellery set — bracelet, necklace & earrings in one box
- Elegant, wearable pieces styled with premium branded cards
- Indulgent chocolate treats included for that extra sweet touch
- Comes fully gift-ready in a luxe pink box — no extra wrapping needed
- Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or premium corporate/festive gifting
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
